question.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
A supportable comparison requires formal R&S specifications/features for the signaling and non-signaling products, official competitor documentation or third-party evidence for competitor claims, and matching test conditions, option codes, versions, calibration/tolerance limits, and validation reports; internal sales battle cards alone are not binding technical evidence and should not be used as the sole basis for customer-facing claims [9][12][27].
### Required evidence
| Claim type to compare | Evidence required before using the claim |
|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 signaling capabilities | Use the formal CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32; the specs document is for binding specifications and hardware/order/configuration data, while the features document covers GUI, software features, signaling/application/measurement options and interfaces [62]. |
| R&S CMX500 technical limits | Use CMX500 specifications with limits and their stated conditions; non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, measured values and data without tolerance limits are not guaranteed or binding [49][62]. |
| R&S CMX500 supported technologies | Cite formal CMX500 evidence for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, fading, FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing and hardware configurations [2][49]. |
| R&S CMX500 WLAN / signaling options | Cite the CMX500 features document for specific WLAN and cellular signaling option codes such as CMX-KS350B through CMX-KS365B for WLAN and CMX-KS500B / CMX-KS600B-series / CMX-KS617B / CMX-KS627B-series for LTE, NR, RedCap and NTN signaling [63][65]. |
| R&S CMX500 automation / workflow claims | Cite the CMX500 features document for CMsquares, CMXmars, CMsequencer, XLAPI and SCPI, including the stated XLAPI Python 3.10 environment and CMX-KF600X installation package [64]. |
| R&S CMP180 non-signaling / production claims | Use CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 and CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00; the features document is an overview and states that measurement ranges and tolerance limits must be taken from specifications document PD 3609.7348.22 [21]. |
| R&S CMP180 hardware and multiport claims | Cite CMP180 evidence for simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing, RF generator/analyzer no. 1 and optional RF generator/analyzer no. 2, and the RF unit / port configuration rather than inferring production capability from product naming [20][87]. |
| R&S CMP200 non-signaling FR2 claims | Use CMP200 Specifications Data Sheet Version 08.00 for claims that CMP200 with CMPHEAD30 / CMPHEAD50 forms a 5G NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution for R&D and manufacturing high-volume RF parametric testing [52][55]. |
| R&S CMP200 binding limits | Use only CMP200 specifications with limits for guaranteed product performance; data without tolerance limits is not binding, and n. trc., typ., nom. and meas. values are not guaranteed [55]. |
| Competitor technical capabilities | Obtain competitor official datasheets, product brochures, specifications, release notes, option/license documents, or third-party evidence; R&S internal battle-card claims about Amarisoft, Anritsu or Keysight require official competitor material or third-party evidence before use in customer documents [9][12][27]. |
| Anritsu comparison claims | Do not rely only on the R&S Anritsu battle card because it is sales positioning and not binding specifications; Anritsu MT8000A numeric claims such as FR2 43.5 GHz, 800 MHz BW, 5 Gbps or FR3 0.4–16 GHz require Anritsu official sources [10][32]. |
| Keysight comparison claims | Do not rely only on the R&S Keysight battle card because it is sales positioning and not binding specifications; the source lacks official Keysight document numbers, versions, order numbers and dates for E7515P, E7515W, E7515B, E7515E and E7515R [13][25]. |
| Amarisoft comparison claims | Do not rely only on the R&S Amarisoft battle card because it is sales positioning, and Amarisoft claims currently have only the R&S internal battle card as source unless official Amarisoft or third-party evidence is added [7][9]. |
| “Only,” “first,” “leadership,” “future-proof,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes” claims | Treat these as sales language unless backed by formal evidence; the passages explicitly warn that such claims are not verifiable technical specifications and need formal evidence before use [9][12][27][82]. |
| FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth and data-rate comparisons | Require formal specifications, supported configurations and test conditions; battle-card figures conflict with formal CMX500 specification framing and cannot be used directly as binding specifications [39][81]. |
| RFU18 / FR3 roadmap claims | Require RFU18 formal datasheet, order number, release date, supported CMX500 configurations, calibration conditions and availability; existing sources explicitly say these are unresolved or PR/demo-level rather than formal specifications [13][37][38]. |
| Aggregated bandwidth claims | Require band combination, carrier count, SCS, modulation, MIMO layers, test conditions and binding tolerance; the Keysight battle card’s RFU18 aggregated bandwidth claim lacks these details [13]. |
| Conformance / operator acceptance claims | Require test package option codes, accreditation documents, official validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB/GCF database exports or equivalent official evidence; the Amarisoft comparison source lacks test package option codes or accreditation evidence [72]. |
| NTN validation claims | Require validation report, test case list, PTCRB RFT 555 version or date; the Samsung NR-NTN validation claim lacks these details [13]. |
| TCO, price, market share or commercial advantage claims | Require formal quotes, contracts, official price lists, third-party market reports or documented TCO calculation; internal price-point, market-share and TCO statements are identified as internal sales / battle-card context and not competitor specification evidence [46][48][58][74]. |
| Support, warranty and calibration-service comparisons | Require official R&S service/calibration/warranty documents and official competitor support/warranty/calibration documents; the Amarisoft comparison’s support and calibration statements lack third-party or Amarisoft official documentation [72]. |
### Bottom line
A defensible Wireless Communication comparison should separate R&S verified product facts, competitor verified product facts, and any sales-positioning statements; if a claim is only in an R&S battle card, the passages require additional official competitor or third-party evidence before using it as a technical comparison [9][12][27].

answer.question: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMW500
R&S CMW500 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Wideband radio communication tester；[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]（Version 17.00，April 2023）列出的訂購型號為 R&S®CMW500，Order No. 1201.0002K50；[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024，文件版次來源未標示）補充其搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 時的 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試支援狀態。

R&S CMW500 › 重要限制
- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。
- 多個 CEN/TS 17240 IVS 測試需要外部 HMI interaction、ignition switched OFF 控制、manufacturer specific AT command、IVS debugging tool、prepared TestUSIM 或 handset；這些不完全由 KA09x software 控制。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available；需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 標示 Not available。
- 來源註明 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 [[NGeCall over LTE]] / IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分涉及 handover 的 test cases 尚未實作。

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- “Only R&S” 與 “safe and future-proof choice” 是 battle card 的 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Anritsu]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 架構 | one-platform architecture；FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + Wi-Fi + RF + fading | multiple RF boards、external converters、multiple boxes；另依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]，[[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 是 software-based [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，可用 MAC / PHY Digital-IQ / RF interfaces | battle card 未提供正式 CMX500 RFU18 或 Anritsu module datasheet；MX844030PC brochure 未提供 CMX500 比較資料 |
| FR1 bandwidth | quick table: 500 MHz (& future scalable) | 200/400 MHz fixed limit；landmine 稱 max 400 MHz per module | R&S 500 MHz 口徑與既有 specifications 不完全一致，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| FR2 | up to 50 GHz；source claim >16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth；>10 Gbps data rate | up to 43.5 GHz；800 MHz BW；up to 5 Gbps | R&S up to 50.20 GHz 與 specs 方向一致；>16 GHz bandwidth / >10 Gbps 仍缺正式規格來源 |
| FR3 | via upcoming [[RFU18]]；quick table says up to 18 GHz | new FR3 module 0.4–16 GHz | 兩方數字皆需正式 datasheet 驗證 |
| Fading | integrated / native fading | external PC software / chambers / software | source 未列 option code 對照 |
| IP throughput | native high-throughput IP testing | IP Option 012 + external PC | source 未列 throughput profile 或測試條件 |
| Software | single workflow / unified automation / Test Automation Suite | Battle card says SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC；[[mx844030pc-j1200]] says MX844030PC uses common RTD GUI for protocol test case transfer | battle card 是 R&S sales framing；Anritsu brochure 是 MX844030PC official product framing，兩者不可直接合併成單一事實 |
| WLAN | cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform；Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling inside CMX500 | MT8000A no WLAN；requires [[Anritsu MT8862A]] | CMX500 WLAN 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- 對 [[Anritsu]] 的 battle card 主張目前主要來自 R&S internal battle card；若用於客戶文件，應另查 Anritsu 官方資料與第三方證據。
- [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 是 Anritsu product brochure，可用於描述 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]]、[[Anritsu MD8190A]] 與 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，但不可用來驗證 R&S 對 CMX500 的優勢主張。
- Source 中的 only platform、industry-leading、widest frequency range、lower TCO 等語句是 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth 與 data rate 相關矛盾與限制已集中標註於 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]]。

- [[Keysight]] — 本 battle card 的競品公司。
- [[Keysight UXM]] — 來源中的 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms 總稱。
- [[Keysight E7515P]] — 來源稱 high-end wideband / 5G platform with Wi-Fi as additional capability；quick table 稱 E7515P up to 15 GHz。
- [[Keysight E7515W]] — 來源稱 Wi-Fi 7 / connectivity platform。
- [[Keysight E7515B]] — 來源稱 standard / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515E]] — 來源稱 value / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515R]] — 來源稱 RedCap / IoT-only SKU。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要

### Short answer
A supportable comparison requires formal R&S specifications/features for the signaling and non-signaling products, official competitor documentation or third-party evidence for competitor claims, and matching test conditions, option codes, versions, calibration/tolerance limits, and validation reports; internal sales battle cards alone are not binding technical evidence and should not be used as the sole basis for customer-facing claims [9][12][27].
### Required evidence
| Claim type to compare | Evidence required before using the claim |
|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 signaling capabilities | Use the formal CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32; the specs document is for binding specifications and hardware/order/configuration data, while the features document covers GUI, software features, signaling/application/measurement options and interfaces [62]. |
| R&S CMX500 technical limits | Use CMX500 specifications with limits and their stated conditions; non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, measured values and data without tolerance limits are not guaranteed or binding [49][62]. |
| R&S CMX500 supported technologies | Cite formal CMX500 evidence for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, fading, FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing and hardware configurations [2][49]. |
| R&S CMX500 WLAN / signaling options | Cite the CMX500 features document for specific WLAN and cellular signaling option codes such as CMX-KS350B through CMX-KS365B for WLAN and CMX-KS500B / CMX-KS600B-series / CMX-KS617B / CMX-KS627B-series for LTE, NR, RedCap and NTN signaling [63][65]. |
| R&S CMX500 automation / workflow claims | Cite the CMX500 features document for CMsquares, CMXmars, CMsequencer, XLAPI and SCPI, including the stated XLAPI Python 3.10 environment and CMX-KF600X installation package [64]. |
| R&S CMP180 non-signaling / production claims | Use CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 and CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00; the features document is an overview and states that measurement ranges and tolerance limits must be taken from specifications document PD 3609.7348.22 [21]. |
| R&S CMP180 hardware and multiport claims | Cite CMP180 evidence for simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing, RF generator/analyzer no. 1 and optional RF generator/analyzer no. 2, and the RF unit / port configuration rather than inferring production capability from product naming [20][87]. |
| R&S CMP200 non-signaling FR2 claims | Use CMP200 Specifications Data Sheet Version 08.00 for claims that CMP200 with CMPHEAD30 / CMPHEAD50 forms a 5G NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution for R&D and manufacturing high-volume RF parametric testing [52][55]. |
| R&S CMP200 binding limits | Use only CMP200 specifications with limits for guaranteed product performance; data without tolerance limits is not binding, and n. trc., typ., nom. and meas. values are not guaranteed [55]. |
| Competitor technical capabilities | Obtain competitor official datasheets, product brochures, specifications, release notes, option/license documents, or third-party evidence; R&S internal battle-card claims about Amarisoft, Anritsu or Keysight require official competitor material or third-party evidence before use in customer documents [9][12][27]. |
| Anritsu comparison claims | Do not rely only on the R&S Anritsu battle card because it is sales positioning and not binding specifications; Anritsu MT8000A numeric claims such as FR2 43.5 GHz, 800 MHz BW, 5 Gbps or FR3 0.4–16 GHz require Anritsu official sources [10][32]. |
| Keysight comparison claims | Do not rely only on the R&S Keysight battle card because it is sales positioning and not binding specifications; the source lacks official Keysight document numbers, versions, order numbers and dates for E7515P, E7515W, E7515B, E7515E and E7515R [13][25]. |
| Amarisoft comparison claims | Do not rely only on the R&S Amarisoft battle card because it is sales positioning, and Amarisoft claims currently have only the R&S internal battle card as source unless official Amarisoft or third-party evidence is added [7][9]. |
| “Only,” “first,” “leadership,” “future-proof,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes” claims | Treat these as sales language unless backed by formal evidence; the passages explicitly warn that such claims are not verifiable technical specifications and need formal evidence before use [9][12][27][82]. |
| FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth and data-rate comparisons | Require formal specifications, supported configurations and test conditions; battle-card figures conflict with formal CMX500 specification framing and cannot be used directly as binding specifications [39][81]. |
| RFU18 / FR3 roadmap claims | Require RFU18 formal datasheet, order number, release date, supported CMX500 configurations, calibration conditions and availability; existing sources explicitly say these are unresolved or PR/demo-level rather than formal specifications [13][37][38]. |
| Aggregated bandwidth claims | Require band combination, carrier count, SCS, modulation, MIMO layers, test conditions and binding tolerance; the Keysight battle card’s RFU18 aggregated bandwidth claim lacks these details [13]. |
| Conformance / operator acceptance claims | Require test package option codes, accreditation documents, official validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB/GCF database exports or equivalent official evidence; the Amarisoft comparison source lacks test package option codes or accreditation evidence [72]. |
| NTN validation claims | Require validation report, test case list, PTCRB RFT 555 version or date; the Samsung NR-NTN validation claim lacks these details [13]. |
| TCO, price, market share or commercial advantage claims | Require formal quotes, contracts, official price lists, third-party market reports or documented TCO calculation; internal price-point, market-share and TCO statements are identified as internal sales / battle-card context and not competitor specification evidence [46][48][58][74]. |
| Support, warranty and calibration-service comparisons | Require official R&S service/calibration/warranty documents and official competitor support/warranty/calibration documents; the Amarisoft comparison’s support and calibration statements lack third-party or Amarisoft official documentation [72]. |
### Bottom line
A defensible Wireless Communication comparison should separate R&S verified product facts, competitor verified product facts, and any sales-positioning statements; if a claim is only in an R&S battle card, the passages require additional official competitor or third-party evidence before using it as a technical comparison [9][12][27].

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + Fading + IP**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system，對比 Anritsu 的 MT8000A、MT8862A、IP Option 012 + external PC、external fading chambers 與 separate RF boards。
- **FR2 / FR3 performance leadership**：主張 R&S up to 50 GHz FR2、>16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth、>10 Gbps data rates 與 FR3 via RFU18；使用時需加註非正式規格限制。
- **Integrated WLAN signaling**：主張 R&S Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling directly inside CMX500，Anritsu 需 separate MT8862A。
- **R&D → Conformance → Production**：CMX500、CMW500、CMP180、CMP200、CMW100 構成 one vendor / one workflow / full lifecycle。
- **Future-proof technology**：Validated NTN、ORAN ORU / Conformance with partners、FR3 beyond 16 GHz、RedCap Rel-17/18。
- **Unified software ecosystem**：R&S Test Automation Suite 與 unified user experience；對比 Anritsu SSNR、RTD、ATS、MX844030PC。此項與 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 對 MX844030PC common RTD GUI 的說明並列保留，使用時需標明來源層次。
- **Fewer Boxes. More Capability.**：以 fewer calibrations、fewer licenses、lower TCO、higher test throughput 作為 sales message；來源未提供 TCO 算式。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMW500
R&S CMW500 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Wideband radio communication tester；[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]（Version 17.00，April 2023）列出的訂購型號為 R&S®CMW500，Order No. 1201.0002K50；[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024，文件版次來源未標示）補充其搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 時的 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試支援狀態。

R&S CMW500 › 重要限制
- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。
- 多個 CEN/TS 17240 IVS 測試需要外部 HMI interaction、ignition switched OFF 控制、manufacturer specific AT command、IVS debugging tool、prepared TestUSIM 或 handset；這些不完全由 KA09x software 控制。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available；需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 標示 Not available。
- 來源註明 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 [[NGeCall over LTE]] / IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分涉及 handover 的 test cases 尚未實作。

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示 published date；raw created 2026-09-11；demo 日期 March 2 to 5, 2026）：

- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully demonstrated carrier aggregation across [[FR1]] and [[FR3]] frequency ranges。

- Test setup 核心是 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester，extended with new [[RFU18]] board to provide coverage up to **18 GHz**。
- 來源稱 [[RFU18]] is a modular hardware upgrade for the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，讓 existing testers extend towards [[6G]]。
- 來源稱 all existing [[R&S CMX500]] platforms can be enhanced with new [[RFU18]] board to extend frequency coverage and capabilities without replacing the entire system。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] engineered for data rates up to **20 Gbps**，supporting wide dynamic range、[[4096QAM]] 與 up to **16 device antenna ports**。

### Short answer
A supportable comparison requires formal R&S specifications/features for the signaling and non-signaling products, official competitor documentation or third-party evidence for competitor claims, and matching test conditions, option codes, versions, calibration/tolerance limits, and validation reports; internal sales battle cards alone are not binding technical evidence and should not be used as the sole basis for customer-facing claims [9][12][27].
### Required evidence
| Claim type to compare | Evidence required before using the claim |
|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 signaling capabilities | Use the formal CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32; the specs document is for binding specifications and hardware/order/configuration data, while the features document covers GUI, software features, signaling/application/measurement options and interfaces [62]. |
| R&S CMX500 technical limits | Use CMX500 specifications with limits and their stated conditions; non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, measured values and data without tolerance limits are not guaranteed or binding [49][62]. |
| R&S CMX500 supported technologies | Cite formal CMX500 evidence for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, fading, FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing and hardware configurations [2][49]. |
| R&S CMX500 WLAN / signaling options | Cite the CMX500 features document for specific WLAN and cellular signaling option codes such as CMX-KS350B through CMX-KS365B for WLAN and CMX-KS500B / CMX-KS600B-series / CMX-KS617B / CMX-KS627B-series for LTE, NR, RedCap and NTN signaling [63][65]. |
| R&S CMX500 automation / workflow claims | Cite the CMX500 features document for CMsquares, CMXmars, CMsequencer, XLAPI and SCPI, including the stated XLAPI Python 3.10 environment and CMX-KF600X installation package [64]. |
| R&S CMP180 non-signaling / production claims | Use CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 and CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00; the features document is an overview and states that measurement ranges and tolerance limits must be taken from specifications document PD 3609.7348.22 [21]. |
| R&S CMP180 hardware and multiport claims | Cite CMP180 evidence for simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing, RF generator/analyzer no. 1 and optional RF generator/analyzer no. 2, and the RF unit / port configuration rather than inferring production capability from product naming [20][87]. |
| R&S CMP200 non-signaling FR2 claims | Use CMP200 Specifications Data Sheet Version 08.00 for claims that CMP200 with CMPHEAD30 / CMPHEAD50 forms a 5G NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution for R&D and manufacturing high-volume RF parametric testing [52][55]. |
| R&S CMP200 binding limits | Use only CMP200 specifications with limits for guaranteed product performance; data without tolerance limits is not binding, and n. trc., typ., nom. and meas. values are not guaranteed [55]. |
| Competitor technical capabilities | Obtain competitor official datasheets, product brochures, specifications, release notes, option/license documents, or third-party evidence; R&S internal battle-card claims about Amarisoft, Anritsu or Keysight require official competitor material or third-party evidence before use in customer documents [9][12][27]. |
| Anritsu comparison claims | Do not rely only on the R&S Anritsu battle card because it is sales positioning and not binding specifications; Anritsu MT8000A numeric claims such as FR2 43.5 GHz, 800 MHz BW, 5 Gbps or FR3 0.4–16 GHz require Anritsu official sources [10][32]. |
| Keysight comparison claims | Do not rely only on the R&S Keysight battle card because it is sales positioning and not binding specifications; the source lacks official Keysight document numbers, versions, order numbers and dates for E7515P, E7515W, E7515B, E7515E and E7515R [13][25]. |
| Amarisoft comparison claims | Do not rely only on the R&S Amarisoft battle card because it is sales positioning, and Amarisoft claims currently have only the R&S internal battle card as source unless official Amarisoft or third-party evidence is added [7][9]. |
| “Only,” “first,” “leadership,” “future-proof,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes” claims | Treat these as sales language unless backed by formal evidence; the passages explicitly warn that such claims are not verifiable technical specifications and need formal evidence before use [9][12][27][82]. |
| FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth and data-rate comparisons | Require formal specifications, supported configurations and test conditions; battle-card figures conflict with formal CMX500 specification framing and cannot be used directly as binding specifications [39][81]. |
| RFU18 / FR3 roadmap claims | Require RFU18 formal datasheet, order number, release date, supported CMX500 configurations, calibration conditions and availability; existing sources explicitly say these are unresolved or PR/demo-level rather than formal specifications [13][37][38]. |
| Aggregated bandwidth claims | Require band combination, carrier count, SCS, modulation, MIMO layers, test conditions and binding tolerance; the Keysight battle card’s RFU18 aggregated bandwidth claim lacks these details [13]. |
| Conformance / operator acceptance claims | Require test package option codes, accreditation documents, official validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB/GCF database exports or equivalent official evidence; the Amarisoft comparison source lacks test package option codes or accreditation evidence [72]. |
| NTN validation claims | Require validation report, test case list, PTCRB RFT 555 version or date; the Samsung NR-NTN validation claim lacks these details [13]. |
| TCO, price, market share or commercial advantage claims | Require formal quotes, contracts, official price lists, third-party market reports or documented TCO calculation; internal price-point, market-share and TCO statements are identified as internal sales / battle-card context and not competitor specification evidence [46][48][58][74]. |
| Support, warranty and calibration-service comparisons | Require official R&S service/calibration/warranty documents and official competitor support/warranty/calibration documents; the Amarisoft comparison’s support and calibration statements lack third-party or Amarisoft official documentation [72]. |
### Bottom line
A defensible Wireless Communication comparison should separate R&S verified product facts, competitor verified product facts, and any sales-positioning statements; if a claim is only in an R&S battle card, the passages require additional official competitor or third-party evidence before using it as a technical comparison [9][12][27].
